page_title: AUG 2-1 EIN | Augsburg v Eintracht Frankfurt 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Harm Osmers has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post.
90+4' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
90+3' Iago (Augsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+3' The game is interrupted now, Iago (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

90+1' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley to the bottom left corner, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.
87' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Finn Dahmen.
86' Neat passing move from Eintracht Frankfurt in order to create new attacking opportunities.
84' 37:63 – the ratio of ball possession.
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Arne Engels (Augsburg) is replacing Niklas Dorsch.
84' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Ermedin Demirovic will be replaced by Sven Michel (Augsburg).
83' Eintracht Frankfurt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
82' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch for Hugo Larsson.
80' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
78' 2 - 1 Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) puts the ball into his own net whilst attempting to block a cross. What bad luck!
77' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Dion Beljo (Augsburg) replaces Phillip Tietz.

76' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Kevin Trapp anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
75' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' The Augsburg players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

74' Play continues despite the shouts by some Augsburg players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Harm Osmers interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
74' PENALTY APPEAL by Augsburg, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
73' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

72' A sweet pass finds Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Finn Dahmen is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
67' Substitution. Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) has come on for Fredrik Jensen.
65' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
64' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Finn Dahmen, who smothers the ball.
64' Here is a change. Ansgar Knauff is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kristijan Jakic (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch so that Junior Dina Ebimbe can be given a rest.
61' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
58' 2 - 0 Iago (Augsburg) latches onto a deep cross on the edge of the penalty box and scores a beautiful goal after firing the ball inside the right post!
57' A cross from Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
57' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
57' The attendance for today's match is 25000.
53' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.
48' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
46' Dino Toppmoller makes a switch. Fares Chaibi is coming on in place of Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replaced by Niels Nkounkou.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A pass from Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by Finn Dahmen and the move breaks down.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Finn Dahmen, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
44' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
40' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) is able to continue to play.
40' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes it short.
36' Eintracht Frankfurt control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

35' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Ermedin Demirovic slips the ball through to Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the top left corner. He makes it 1:0.
34' Eintracht Frankfurt are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

31' Augsburg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
30' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Augsburg players look gutted.
30' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Augsburg players aren’t happy.
28' Goal! Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
27' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
24' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
23' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
20' Augsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
18' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
18' Eintracht Frankfurt keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

17' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Kevin Trapp has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
17' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
15' Wasted opportunity! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
14' Eintracht Frankfurt string together a series of short passes.
13' A long pass, executed by Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg), missed the precision to reach his teammates.

11' Augsburg are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
11' A cross into the box from Iago (Augsburg) is cleared.

9' A big opportunity is wasted by Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Finn Dahmen pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.

9' Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Harm Osmers with no other option than to blow for a foul.
8' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
8' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
7' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.

5' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Augsburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
4' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
3' Eintracht Frankfurt keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
2' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
2' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Harm Osmers.
